name: Switches
summary: Switches of every kind: toggles, rockers, microswitches, limit and float switches, and push buttons.
uses: Power switches and controls for builds
identify: Rocker switches on power strips and appliances; microswitches in the doors of microwaves, washers and printers; float switches in sump pits and tanks; toggles on tools and dashboards. The rating in amps and volts is stamped on the body.
test: Continuity across the terminals should change cleanly when switched. Microswitches have common, NO and NC terminals.
